scope: AEC classification of the150 electorates used at the2025 federal election, not subsequently redistributed boundaries.

definitions.Inner Metropolitan: Situated in capital cities and consisting of well-established built-up suburbs.
definitions.Outer Metropolitan: Situated in capital cities and containing large areas of recent suburban expansion.
definitions.Provincial: Outside capital cities, but with a majority of enrolment in major provincial cities.
definitions.Rural: Outside capital cities and without majority of enrolment in major provincial cities.

metro_rule: is_metro=1 exactly when AEC category is Inner Metropolitan or Outer Metropolitan. Provincial and Rural remain nonmetro. No custom city-boundary inference.

validation.crosswalk: Exact case-insensitive officialDivisionNm + StateAb, all150 matched one-to-one to existing nationalAEC DivisionID crosswalk
